name: losperitos
description: A desktop workspace for running a team of coding agents on your own machine.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @losperitos/ui && npm run build --workspace @losperitos/desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run build:all && npm run start --workspace @losperitos/desktop
scripts.desktop:demo: npm run build:all && npm run start --workspace @losperitos/desktop -- --fake
